02 Negatives

Don't & doesn't

don'tI · you · we · they
I don't eat pancakes.
They don't play soccer.
doesn'the · she · it
She doesn't drink milk.
He doesn't do karate.
Com doesn't, o verbo volta à forma básica, sem -s: She doesn't drink milk (e não drinks).
